ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels localized in the central lobe regions vs 30% low-intensity black pixels at the margins and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric central white fields on both lobes; thick black border along the trailing edges; high-density black mottling and stochastic speckling at the anterior junction where lobes meet the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees and shallow depth relative to total fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with irregular, low-amplitude pixel-level oscillations (peaks and valleys); serration frequency increases at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory transitioning into a gentle sigmoid curve along the trailing edge toward the medial notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct high-intensity white marking or scar visible on the apex/leading edge of the dorsal fin of the second individual; minor irregular tissue loss on the distal right fluke lobe margin.
